text: Florence Crescent is a 7.3 metres wide roadway classified as a "local" road. This street has a one-way westbound to southbound operation, starting from Jane Street and terminating at St. Clair Avenue West. There are sidewalks on both sides of this street, which has a posted speed limit of 40 km/h. In response to a petition submitted to my office for traffic calming, Transportation Services conducted speed and volume counts on the street and determined that the technical warrants for traffic calming were not met and so a reduction in the speed limit to 30 km/hr is being sought instead.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Florence Crescent, between Jane Street and St. Clair Avenue West.
